payload.title: P5-02: Papyrus: papyrus-app sync mounts the reader under the base path; release the package
payload.description:
## Goal
A publication repo can mount the Pretext reader under `/information` with `papyrus-app sync`, leave `/` to a site-owned page, and keep `/newsroom`, the staging gate and robots working. A new `@anthusai/papyrus` next version is published containing P5-01 and this change.

## Context (FACT)
- `packages/papyrus/src/sync.mjs` writes a one-line shim for every route in `routes.manifest.json` plus `middleware.ts`; it skips a path only when a site-owned file exists (no GENERATED marker). There is no way to relocate or omit routes, so `app/[year]`, `app/articles`, `app/archive` would stay at the root.
- `app/page.tsx` (reader home) is overridable by a site-owned `app/page.tsx` (that is how marketing owns `/`), but the dated routes would still answer at `/2026/october/07` (a duplicate of the prefixed ones).
- `middleware.ts`: `isStagingGatedPath` gates everything except `/newsroom`, `/api`, static files and `/robots.txt`; anonymous staging visitors redirect to `/newsroom` (hardcoded). `usesNewsroomRootPaths` only applies to a `newsroomBasePath === ""` brand. Both are prefix-agnostic.
- `app/robots.ts` is site-wide; `/sitemap.xml` does not exist on develop (production main also 404s; `/robots.txt` 404s on the deployed main build, which is 97 commits behind develop).
- The staging static preview excludes `/newsroom`, `/api` (lib/staging-preview-object.ts); not used for Pretext.

## Exact steps
1. Gherkin: "sync with readerBasePath /information writes reader shims under app/information and none at the root", "a site-owned app/page.tsx is kept", "GET / is the site page, GET /information is the newspaper home, GET /2026/october/07 is 404, GET /newsroom is 200".
2. Mark reader routes in the manifest generator (`packages/papyrus/scripts/stage.mjs`) with `reader: true` (home, `[year]/...`, `articles/[slug]`, `archive`, `settings`).
3. `sync` reads the brand's `readerBasePath` (via papyrus.config.ts) and writes reader shims at `app/<base>/...`; the reader home becomes `app/<base>/page.tsx`. Root `app/page.tsx` is then generated only when the base path is empty.
4. `/newsroom`, `/api/*`, `/_preview` stay at root. Add the scenarios to the scratch publication-repo test (the Pilobol.us spike harness).
5. Release: PR to develop, Ryan merges, semantic-release publishes the next prerelease; record the version.

## Acceptance checks
- In a scratch publication repo (not committed): `papyrus-app sync` then `next build` succeeds; with a stub `app/page.tsx`: `/` 200 (stub), `/information` 200, `/information/archive` 200, `/2026/october/07` 404, `/articles/x` 404, `/newsroom` 200, `/robots.txt` 200.
- With SITE_ENV=staging and no session: `/` and `/information` redirect to `/newsroom` once (no loop); `/newsroom` 200.
- Generated shims are gitignored; running sync twice is a no-op.
- `npm view @anthusai/papyrus@next version` shows the release.

## Rollback
Revert the PR; sites with no `readerBasePath` get today's shims.

## Risks
Static route params collide between a site-owned root `app/page.tsx` and generated ones (covered by the skip rule); prerelease pins move (use exact pin in the repo).

## Needs Ryan
PR merge and the package release.
